errorIncidents.title: FCM Push Token Socket Timeout
errorIncidents.rootCause: FCM push registration token expired for KDS Android Tablet (Device #KDS-02). Network socket timed out after 3000ms.
errorIncidents.impact: KDS audible bell delayed by 1.2 seconds; fallbacked to Supabase Realtime broadcast sound chime.
errorIncidents.recovery: Automatic fallback to WebAudio API chime in browser + token re-registered on next heartbeat.

errorIncidents.title: BOM Reservation Lock (Low Stock)
errorIncidents.rootCause: Attempted to reserve 1.20L of Fresh Lemon Juice for batch ORD-1209, but only 0.94L available in stock.
errorIncidents.impact: Reservation throttled; kitchen warned with Low Stock alert modal on KDS.
errorIncidents.recovery: Partial reservation held at 0.94L; Waiter alerted to recommend alternative or replenish inventory.

errorIncidents.title: Concurrency Double-Tap Intercepted
errorIncidents.rootCause: Line cook double-clicked "Preparing" button within 94 milliseconds on touch screen.
errorIncidents.impact: Second API call payload matched identical idempotency_key.
errorIncidents.recovery: Idempotency guard returned HTTP 200 cached response; duplicate stock deduction blocked (exactly-once guaranteed).

errorIncidents.title: SQLite Offline Queue Sync Merge
errorIncidents.rootCause: Table 10 handheld lost Wi-Fi during lunch rush; 1 status change queued locally in IndexedDB / SQLite.
errorIncidents.recovery: Upon Wi-Fi reconnect, queued event synced via POST /api/staff/update-order-status with 0 duplicate orders.

errorIncidents.title: UPI Gateway Webhook Callback Delay
errorIncidents.rootCause: Bank UPI switch delayed webhook callback response by 45 seconds.
errorIncidents.impact: Customer screen showed "Verifying payment with bank...".
errorIncidents.recovery: Cashier clicked "Verify with Reference No." and successfully marked paid via Cash backup tender.

nodes.label: QR Scan & Table Detect
nodes.description: Customer scans dynamic table QR code; parses restaurant slug and table ID from URL query.

nodes.label: Interactive Digital Menu
nodes.description: Displays menu items categorized with live stock badges, veg/non-veg tags, and portion prices.

nodes.label: Client Cart State
nodes.description: Stores selected dishes, portion variants (Half/Full), quantities, and special kitchen notes.

nodes.label: Special Instructions
nodes.description: Collects dish-level preparation instructions (e.g., less spicy, no onion) saved into order items.

nodes.label: Checkout & Order Review
nodes.description: Displays itemized bill preview, GST breakdown, discount codes, and order submission button.

nodes.label: Order Placement Engine
nodes.description: Inserts order header and initial batch in status "new", creates item rows, holds stock reservations.

nodes.label: Batch Status: New
nodes.description: Initial state of an order batch upon placement. Active stock reservations held; 0 consumption.

nodes.label: Batch Status: Accepted
nodes.description: Batch acknowledged by kitchen; records accepted_at timestamp, dispatches realtime broadcast.

nodes.label: Batch Status: Preparing
nodes.description: Cooking started. Triggers exact-once inventory consumption: reservations flip ACTIVE -> CONSUMED.

nodes.label: Batch Status: Ready
nodes.description: Food prepared and ready on the pass. Records ready_at; sends chime and notification to waiters.

nodes.label: Batch Status: Served
nodes.description: Delivered to customer table. Idempotent check ensures zero extra stock deduction.

nodes.label: Cancel & Disposition
nodes.description: Cancels batch. Releases reservations if unstarted, or records food disposition/waste if prepared.

nodes.label: Reject Order Branch
nodes.description: Kitchen rejects order with reason (e.g. out of stock); releases active reservations immediately.

nodes.label: Batch Status Recall
nodes.description: Reverts mistaken status transitions while strictly preserving inventory transaction safety.

nodes.label: Idempotency Protection
nodes.description: Deterministic key ORDER_CONSUMPTION_<orderId>_<batchId> guarantees stock is consumed exactly once.

nodes.label: Duplicate Request Deduplication
nodes.description: Computes SHA/payload_hash and inspects seenKeys to prevent re-submitting synchronized actions.

nodes.label: KDS Live Station Screen
nodes.description: Visual station board categorizing batches into New, Preparing, and Ready columns.

nodes.label: KDS Accept Action
nodes.description: Kitchen confirms order receipt. Dispatches status update to server via authenticated staff API.

nodes.label: KDS Start Prep Action
nodes.description: Puts ticket into cooking mode, invoking inventory deduction engine on the server.

nodes.label: KDS Mark Ready Action
nodes.description: Signals cooking complete. Moves ticket to ready column and triggers waiter dispatch alert.

nodes.label: KDS Reject Ticket Action
nodes.description: Prompts chef for rejection reason, marks batch rejected, and releases stock reservations.

nodes.label: Kitchen Chime & Bell Audio
nodes.description: Synthesizes audio bell tone when new order arrives to alert busy kitchen staff immediately.

nodes.label: KDS Realtime WebSocket Channel
nodes.description: Listens for order_batches INSERT and UPDATE events to refresh KDS board with sub-100ms latency.

nodes.label: Customer Waiter Call

nodes.label: Order Pickup Alert

nodes.label: Serve to Table Action

nodes.label: Table Floor Status Management

nodes.label: Executive Overview

nodes.label: Live Orders Management

nodes.label: Recipe & Ingredient Mapping
